meta.note: Institutions held by quality score: elite papers (the world's roughly 50,000 most-cited papers of 2017–2026, 478+ citations; papers with over 100 authors count a tenth) divided by the square root of its papers in thousands, times its h-index over 100. The world's top 240 are held, then, with a score of at least 25, the top 5 in each country with 200+ elite papers, the top 10 in each field by its own highly cited papers and the top 3 in each subfield by those papers for their size.
